verdict.rationale: BILL documents a comprehensive sandbox for the v3 API where developers can test workflows end to end without moving real money, and that API platform includes Spend & Expense. The sandbox description uses AP examples (bills to payments), so S&E-specific sandbox coverage is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that S&E endpoints (cards, budgets, reimbursements) work in the sandbox, details on sandbox provisioning and data isolation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
